verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of LM Studio's licensing terms, commercial-use policy, or any paid or enterprise tier, so there is no product-documented answer to whether commercial use needs a paid license. Only community comments (comm-8, comm-15) say the license historically barred work use. These are secondhand, possibly outdated, and do not show the product itself clearly communicating commercial terms.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
